'''Adostic Arms''' was a weapons manufacturer known for its large-bore projectile [[Shotgun/Legends|shotguns]].<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|12|Adostic Arms}}</ref> Among its products were the [[8-gauge scatter gun]],<ref name="FC" /> a weapon favored by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] operative [[Thar'quan]].
